instrument_verdict: TRUSTWORTHY WITHIN A STATED BOUND. It may claim presence/absence for any source whose bytes it fetched and hashed, when the positive control passed; it may claim SECTION attribution only where an arXiv e-print exists. It may NOT claim section attribution from a rendered PDF alone, and it has been validated against exactly ONE source.
known_bounds: Validated on ONE source. Every new source needs its own positive control; there is no general proof.
Section attribution requires a LaTeX e-print. Sources without one support presence/absence claims only.
Set alignment across distinct extractors is approximate; the counts are the hard fact.
Soft-hyphen and cross-line probe-term breaking are handled but UNEXERCISED here — do not claim they are tested.
A paywalled source cannot be attested at all: the outcome is DERIVED-AND-MEASURED or UNSOURCED, never a substituted second unverified citation.
